description_en: Creates a robot in the sandbox environment
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot create-instance --name '小蜜机器人' --language-code zh-cn --introduction '用于手机app的小蜜机器人' --robot-type scenario_im --agent-key ac627989eb4f8a98ed05fd098bbae5_p_beebot_public --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en: The name of the robot. The maximum length is 50 characters
parameters.help_zh: 机器人名称，不超过50个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The language of the robot, such as `zh-cn` or `en-us`. The language must be supported by the agent. If you omit this parameter, the agent's default language is used
parameters.help_zh: 机器人服务的语言，如zh-cn、en-us，默认值为业务空间的默认语言。可选值为业务空间支持的语言
parameters.name: language_code

parameters.example: 用于手机app的小蜜机器人
parameters.help_en: A description of the robot. The description can be up to 50 characters long
parameters.name: introduction

parameters.help_en: The robot type. The default value is `scenario_im`
parameters.name: robot_type

parameters.help_en: The key of the agent. If you omit this parameter, the default agent is used. You can find the key on the Business Management page of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不设置则访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the robot
